annotations.title: Find EV chargers in Poland (UDT EIPA)

description: Use to find EV chargers near a place: fast, free or available chargers. Public EV charging sites in Poland from the UDT register EIPA near a city or a point: give city, or lat and lon with radius_km. Filters: min_kw (e.g. 150 for ultra-fast), free_charging, available_now (at least one point free according to a status younger than 2 hours), network slug, connector (ccs, chademo, type2). Each site: name, address, network, power class (AFIR), maximum kW, points, points free now, lowest ad hoc price per kWh (price for a driver without a contract), distance. Pass id for one site with stations, points, connectors, prices and status. Operators report data; check the price at the charger.

available_now.description: Only sites with a point free right now.

city.description: City, e.g. "Kraków" (with or without Polish letters).

connector.description: Only sites with this connector type.

id.description: Site id from a previous result for the full site card.

network.description: Network slug, e.g. greenway, orlen, tesla, ionity.
